MainController

class MainController(view, model, message_service)[source]

Bases: QObject

Controller of the main window.

Opens the dialogs of the menus, the game actions and the help, and handles the application exit.

Parameters:
viewMainView

The main window; it is also the parent of the controller.

modelAppModel

Global application state.

message_serviceMessageService

Service used to show dialogs.

Attributes:
viewMainView

The main window.

modelAppModel

Global application state.

message_serviceMessageService

Service used to show dialogs.

app_serviceMainService

Global service (exit confirmation).

app_factoryAppViewFactory

Factory of the application views.

handle_exit()[source]

Ask for confirmation and quit the application.

Does nothing if the application is already quitting.

try_close()[source]

Ask for confirmation and quit when the window is closed.

Returns:
bool

True if the application is quitting (the close event can be accepted), False if the user cancelled.

open_game_action(game_name, method, edit_method=None)[source]

Open a dialog provided by a game’s view factory.

Parameters:
game_namestr

Game ID registered in ViewFactory.

methodstr

Name of the factory method that creates the dialog.

edit_methodstr | None, optional

Name of the factory method that creates the edit dialog, passed to the first one when the factory has it. Default is None.

Raises:
KeyError

If no view factory is loaded for game_name.

AttributeError

If the factory has no method.
